scientific_domain: Biostatistics, Missing Reference Control Alignment & Simpson-Confounded Calibration

synthesis_decision.rationale: Primary Antithesis branch satisfied public checks under policy; second branch skipped (`1.00u` nominal units).

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: A logistic model fitted on raw biomarker coordinates transfers across centers as well as a reference-aligned model with the same feature basis.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: In public cohort 1, pooled AUROC/Brier improved from 0.711/0.239 to 0.860/0.150 after alignment, with AUROC improving in both query centers.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: Raw biomarkers mix site-specific measurement distortions with patient signal; controls isolate the measurement component without centering away patient biology.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Use separate biomarker transforms shrunk toward a center anchor, retain clinical stratum, and estimate training-center intercepts without exporting them to query centers.
